title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: The preflight deletion is IMPLEMENTED and COMMITTED as 106b253 on branch fix/delete-merge-boundary-preflight (cut at 4fd03c2). Suite 1771/1770/1, only the named 0210 environment failure. Both code-reviewer and security-reviewer returned APPROVE-WITH-FIXES, no CRITICAL. The MSP is NOT shippable as-is: one HIGH and six MEDIUM findings must land first. NO PR IS OPEN and none should be opened until they do.
spine.next_step: START HERE. Do NOT open the PR yet. Then pr-create.
open_risks: HIGH: every change needs its OWN docs/invariants/coverage/<name>.json with a row for all 12 registry ids. This edited feat-m5-quiescent-exit.json instead. The checker only requires SOME file there be touched, so it goes green while unmet - the assurance inflation 0220 deleted the preflight for.

A STILL-LIVE ASSERTION WAS LOST. 19 of the 20 removed mitosis-scheduler tests were dead; the 20th asserted the reconcile prompt never sources an executable from the repo under management. mitosis.js:3962 still runs node ${LIB_DIR}/fold-run-log.mjs. Restore that one assertion.

no-self-merge-consent reads <repo>/.claude/settings.json but enforcement reads ~/.claude/settings.json, a REGULAR FILE not a symlink. Removing a deny entry from the installed copy leaves the test GREEN while its message claims the guarantee holds. Read the installed path, or assert both.

MERGE_INVOCATION_PATTERNS greps RAW SOURCE, so strengthening a prohibition in prose turns the test red with a message asserting the opposite. mitosis.js already carries seven such prose prohibitions. Fix: match extracted command sites per ghActionSites at tests/gh-scope-lint.test.mjs:23-35.

SECURITY MEDIUM: the new test scans ONLY mitosis.js. A merge verb added to mitosis-git.mjs, the sanctioned gh-exec wrapper and likeliest landing place, passes every assertion. Widen to lib/superpowers-parallel/*.mjs with one named exemption for gh-merge-shim.mjs.

SECURITY MEDIUM, the one property genuinely lost: the gate proved server-side that an approval cannot carry to commits appended later. The CI-to-green loop still appends to a PR mitosis.js:5207 calls one a human may be reading. Remedy: a SKILL.md ruleset line, or refuse to append when APPROVED.

PR BODY: the module is 410 lines and its test 668; 0220's '1078' conflated them. gh-merge-shim.mjs is NOT a PATH-level layer, being imported only by mitosis-git.mjs, so 'three deny layers' overcounts. Do NOT cite the unverified GitHub self-approval claim.

BASELINE CORRECTION: the spine's 1887/1886 does not reproduce. At the same commit 4fd03c2 this session it is 1896/1895/1. Post-change is 1771/1770/1, reconciled per-file as 1896-131+6. Never compare raw totals.
MERGE IS NOT GATED on this repo: no branch protection, no required status checks, so a red CI does not block the merge button. Surface any red in words.
